fi-dunckerocampus-dactyliophorus.title: Banded Pipefish (Ringed Pipefish)
fi-dunckerocampus-dactyliophorus.summary: A slender red-and-white ringed relative of seahorses that hovers near caves and overhangs. Peaceful but delicate: it needs frequent small meaty feedings and calm tankmates.
rows: Yes, but keep it away from stinging corals
Carnivore: copepods, enriched brine shrimp and mysis, several small feedings a day
notes: Give it caves, overhangs and crevices; it can be kept with other pipefish and seahorses.
